name: uk.co.dwlf/mcp-server
title: DWLF
description: Market conditions, events, custom events and backtests as tools. Bitcoin on-chain via DWLF Block.

environmentVariables.name: DWLF_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your DWLF platform API key (dwlf_sk_...). Not needed for keyless DWLF Block (DWLF_TOOL_PROFILE=block, DWLF_BLOCK_BACKEND=block-api). DWLF is in private beta: accounts are invite-only.

environmentVariables.name: DWLF_TOOL_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Tool set: full (default, every tool) or block (the Bitcoin subset for DWLF Block).

environmentVariables.name: DWLF_BLOCK_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: For the block profile: spt (default; the DWLF platform, needs DWLF_API_KEY) or block-api (the Block API: 5 tools, works without a key).

environmentVariables.name: DWLF_BLOCK_KEY
environmentVariables.description: On block-api: a DWLF Block API key (dwlfk_...) for the full history. Without it, the public view (recent history).

environmentVariables.name: BLOCK_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: Block API base URL. Leave unset for production.

environmentVariables.name: DWLF_API_URL
environmentVariables.description: API base URL. Leave unset for production.
